verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Elastic Observability supports alert rules and prebuilt dashboards. Nothing in the pack documents defining dashboards or alerts as code via JSON models, Terraform, or a provisioning API. The ES|QL REST API covers querying data, not provisioning dashboards or rules, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
